newsitem.title: USA: Carver Bancorp sets first dividend at $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Carver Bancorp sets first dividend at $0.05.

text.p: Carver Bancorp Inc said Thursday it declared a cash dividend on its common stock of five cents per share.
The dividend is payable on August 4, 1997 to stockholders of record at the close of business on July 14.

This is the first dividend paid by the company since its acquisition of Carver Federal Savings Bank in connection with the reorganization of the bank as a wholly owned subsidiary of Carver on October 17, 1996.

Carver's board of directors have not determined to establish a regular dividend but will review the company's position after the quarter ending December 3l, 1997 for the possible declaration of additional dividends.
Carver Bancorp, with $424 million in assets, is the holding company for Carver FSB, a federally chartered stock savings bank.
